preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
Each string s must have a length between 2 and 1,000,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l < r <= len(s) and (r - l + 1) % 2 == 0 for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify a valid range [l, r] with an even length.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, int) and output >= 0 for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.
The number of outputs must match the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(output == min_cost(s[l-1:r]) for l, r in queries)
postconditions.description: Each output must correctly compute the minimum cost for the specified substring.
